proposal.reason: Primary change is in P2P transport registration flow: exporting, importing, mapping, and deregistering multi-segment IPC buffers (including segment-count-aware metadata and feature flag wiring). Include memory because alloc/free and unmap logic now handles segment-aware HG memory ownership and teardown semantics. Include network because shared proxy/UDS FD-conversion and proxy-connection handle lifecycle were substantively extended (batch FD query and tracked cleanup), not just mechanical call-site edits.
